breakdown.description: Thermal expansion coefficient beta for an ideal gas is approximately 1/T in absolute units (Kelvin); using Celsius temperature in beta = 1/T is incorrect.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the original flawed notation 'beta = 1/(T_C)' which suggests using temperature in Celsius. While the film temperature is correctly stated as 323.15 K, the formula for beta was not corrected to explicitly use absolute temperature (Kelvin). The ground truth requires 'beta ≈ 1/T_abs evaluated at the film temperature in Kelvin.' The agent failed to fix this critical inconsistency.
